## Independent re-verification (session handoff) + #4497 coordination

A host restart ended the authoring session after this PR was pushed but before its report landed. A second session inherited the branch at `0bbdf0028` and **re-derived every claim in the description from scratch** rather than trusting it. No code changed — the tree is byte-identical to what was pushed (`sha256` checked after each revert/restore cycle), and no new commit was needed.

**Red-first, re-derived.** `DatasetWidget.tsx` reverted to `origin/main` with the new test kept (via `git checkout origin/main -- path`, never `git stash`):

```
FAIL ... > labels the null group `(未指定)` under `zh`, not the English floor
AssertionError: expected [ 'Ada Lovelace', '(None)' ] to include '(未指定)'

FAIL ... > keeps the measure attached to the (now translated) bucket
AssertionError: expected { 'Ada Lovelace': 5, '(None)': 3 } to match object { '(未指定)': 3 }

Tests  3 failed | 4 passed (7)
```

Restored: `Tests 7 passed (7)`.

**One nuance worth stating**, because it is what makes the half-fix run load-bearing rather than decorative: under a *full* revert the PAIR case fails at its **label precondition**, not at the drill — it never reaches the click. So the full revert cannot by itself prove the drill half is needed. Applying **only** the forward argument isolates it exactly:

```
✓ labels the null group `(未指定)` under `zh`, not the English floor
✓ keeps the measure attached to the (now translated) bucket
× PAIR — a click on the localized bucket bar still drills to ITS row
AssertionError: expected 0 to be greater than 0

Tests  1 failed | 6 passed (7)
```

The labels go green and only the drill dies — `drillFilters` stays empty because the drawer never opened. That is the dead-click, reproduced.

**#4497 / PR #4506 — no collision, and a positive interaction.** The two PRs are **file-disjoint**: #4506 touches `core/chart-series.ts`, its test, and a plugin-charts test; this one touches only `plugin-dashboard`. Verified against core as it stands here, `buildChartSeries`' pivot arm does not bucket nulls at all, so the option this PR passes is currently **inert** on that arm — which is why the single-dimension scope is honest. The interaction when #4506 lands is favourable rather than conflicting: because both call sites already read one binding, DatasetWidget's pivot arm inherits the **localized** bucket label for free and correctly paired, with no follow-up edit. No gating needed in either direction.

**Gates re-run locally** (all green): `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/` → **47 files, 388 tests passed** (the #4487 flake did not fire); `type-check` clean; `eslint` **0 errors**; `check:control-bytes`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-no-major` green. `check:i18n-call-site-keys` is the one worth quoting, since this card adds a `tt()` call site — it confirms the key resolves and the inline default matches the pack:

> Every in-scope call-site key resolves against the en pack (2881 keys), every literal inline defaultValue matches the value the pack serves

`.d.ts` re-diffed both ways (built from this branch, then from `origin/main`): `index.d.ts` and `DatasetWidget.d.ts` **identical** — `patch` grading stands.

**CI converged green**: all 20 check runs completed, zero failures — Lint, Type Check, all four test shards, Control Byte Scan and all three changeset gates. Staying draft for PM review.
